title: GovernanceKernelOutput
description: SAIA-Class S schema defining the canonical output envelope produced by the Governance Kernel after evaluating doctrine, policies, identity, predictive signals, wellbeing constraints, and environmental context.

outputId.description: Unique identifier for this governance kernel output envelope.

inputId.description: Identifier of the corresponding governance-kernel-input.json object.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the decision was produced.

decision.description: The final governance decision object produced by the kernel.

appliedDoctrine.description: List of doctrinal rules applied during evaluation.
